defect.caughtOn: owner demo session, S25+ / Chrome 154 (priority security-core fix)
defect.summary: The harness login fixture's <input type="password"> field (label 'Password' NOT associated with the field node) accepted the stub phrase typed FIVE TIMES with no H8/H3/H4 card ever firing - the doc 06 section-2a credential-entry path and the H3/H8 protection law were dark on live Chrome. Root cause chain: (1) the observation never read AccessibilityNodeInfo.isPassword() - the one explicit reliable signal; (2) FieldDescriptor.fromObserved assumed Chrome exposes secret fields as masked-or-empty - Chrome 154 exposes the field's ACTUAL typed content, so the ALL_MASKED value echo matched nothing; (3) the node's serialized text is the typed content, not the label, so the PASSWORD_WORDS wording heuristic missed too.

files: app/src/main/kotlin/navigator/app/harness/HarnessRunners.kt (HarnessObserver threads the flag into the loop's ObservedNodes)
prongs.mechanism: The reader captures AccessibilityNodeInfo.isPassword into NodeSnapshot; the flag threads NodeSnapshot -> HarnessObserver -> ObservedNode -> (a) FieldDescriptor.fromNode at the GATE step and (b) the enumerator's `password` kind so the engine's state text marks the secret field ([nN] "..." edit password (x,y)). The marker is app-authored observation metadata, not page content (ART-4 block untouched).

fromObserved gains `isPassword: Boolean = false`, OR-ed over the existing heuristics (wording / class name / all-masked echo stay as fallback); fromNode passes node.isPassword, so the loop's existing FieldDescriptor.fromNodes(obs.nodes) call sites consume the flag with zero loop changes. The wrong Chrome claim in the fromObserved KDoc was corrected in the same pass (live Chrome 154: actual content echoed, no label association - the flag is primary, heuristics fallback).

h8-type-into-reader-flagged-field (flag + zero wording + garbage content on TYPE -> H8 - the live-defect regression pin), h4-submit-reader-flagged-login-pair (identifier + flagged field, login wording on SUBMIT -> H4), h3-submit-lone-reader-flagged-secret (lone flagged secret on SUBMIT -> H3). H8 never fires on SUBMIT by law (entry-only; submissions are H3/H4's) - the dispatch's 'H4/H8 on submit' resolved to the law's actual classes.

fix.serializationDecision: The [nN] line's kinds segment gains the app-authored token `password` (lowercase, matching the tap/edit/scroll convention), placed after `edit` before `scroll`, identically in TreeSerializer (observation lines) and the enumerator (state-text candidate lines). It informs the engine the field is a secret field; the gate consumes the boolean flag independently of the text.

deviations.deviation: A11yNode (the fixture schema) gained an additive-OPTIONAL isPassword field with default false.
deviations.reason: CaptureMode must record the reader flag or every future real capture would re-encode the blindness this fix closes. Committed fixtures predate the field and decode false unchanged (no fixture edited - fixtures sacred); the strict loader's unknown/missing-key law is untouched (missing decodes to the default, unknown keys still fail loudly). Follows the sanctioned `device`-field precedent; recorded here because the schema is nominally a vision-level surface.
